# FDG8035

> CONSIDER implementing non-generic collection interfaces (`IList` and `ICollection`) if the collection will often be passed to APIs taking these interfaces as input.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 8.3.4 Implementing Custom Collections.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library suggestion, application suggestion, test suggestion
- Status: verified

Not machine-checkable: whether a collection will often be passed to APIs that take the non-generic interfaces is not in the code.

  ...
